description: Declaration of the polar_code_impl class implementing polar code with look-up tables, including static lookup tables for mother codes and interleavers, and methods for configuration and retrieval of code parameters.

classes.name: polar_code_impl
classes.description: Implementation of polar code interface based on look-up tables, providing methods for configuration and parameter access.

methods.name: polar_code_impl
methods.description: Default constructor; initializes an invalid configuration that must be set by the user.

methods.name: get_n
methods.description: Returns the base-2 logarithm of the number of coded bits.

methods.name: get_N
methods.description: Returns the total number of coded bits.

methods.name: get_K
methods.description: Returns the number of message bits (data and CRC).

methods.name: get_E
methods.description: Returns the number of rate-matched encoded bits.

methods.name: get_nPC
methods.description: Returns the number of parity-check bits.

methods.name: get_K_set
methods.description: Returns the set of indices for message bits at the encoder input.

methods.name: get_PC_set
methods.description: Returns the set of indices for parity-check bits at the encoder input.

methods.name: get_F_set
methods.description: Returns the set of indices for frozen bits at the encoder input.

methods.name: get_blk_interleaver
methods.description: Returns the block interleaver pattern for the current code configuration.

methods.name: get_ibil
methods.description: Returns the status of the internal bit interleaver.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Configures the code parameters with message size K, codeword size E, maximum code length nMax, and interleaver settings.
